summary.text: LINJEPARTNER AS is a private limited company registered in Levanger, founded 2013-09-09. LINJEPARTNER AS provides contractor services to grid owners throughout Norway, specializing in work on energised power lines, known as Arbeid Under Spenning (AUS). It was previously named AUS PARTNER AS until 2013-11-04. Its main industry code is 42.222: construction of utility projects for electricity and telecommunications on land. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 115 369 773 NOK and the annual result was 16 258 692 NOK; operating income was down from 205 096 153 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 28 422 592 NOK in 2024 to 16 258 692 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 36 102 857 NOK in 2024 to 27 227 870 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Stig Myhr (daglig leder and styrets leder), with 1 other board member. Its verified website is linjepartner.no. Its website links to a careers page or job board. The registered employee count went from 41 on 2025-11-12 to 57 on 2026-10-13. The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-13 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
